_comment: Agile Agent Team — Antigravity Mission Configuration (Squad Template)
_description: Reusable mission template for the agile agent team. Load this in Antigravity Manager View to pre-configure all four workspaces.

mission.name: Agile Agent Team Mission
mission.description: Replace this with your business goal before launching.

workspaces.name: Product Owner
workspaces.task_template: MISSION BRIEF is in mission.md. Read it. Follow your skill instructions to produce user stories and acceptance criteria. Save all artifacts to artifacts/po/. Save handoff to handoffs/po-to-architect.md.

workspaces.name: Software Architect
workspaces.task_template: Read all PO artifacts in artifacts/po/ and handoffs/po-to-architect.md. Follow your skill instructions to design the architecture. Save artifacts to artifacts/architect/. Save handoffs/architect-to-qa.md and handoffs/architect-to-dev.md.

workspaces.name: QA Engineer (Planning)
workspaces.task_template: You are in PLANNING MODE. Read artifacts/po/acceptance-criteria.md and artifacts/architect/api-contracts.yaml. Write failing tests. Save to tests/ folder. Create tests/run_tests.sh and tests/DEV_HANDOFF.md. Save test plan to artifacts/qa/test-plan.md. Save handoff to handoffs/qa-to-dev.md.

workspaces.name: Developer (Setup)
workspaces.task_template: You are in SETUP MODE. Read artifacts/architect/architecture-decision-record.md and artifacts/architect/task-breakdown.md. Create the project structure, placeholder files, and install dependencies. Do NOT write implementation code. Save handoff to handoffs/dev-setup-complete.md.

workspaces.name: Developer (Implementation)
workspaces.task_template: You are in IMPLEMENTATION MODE. Read tests/DEV_HANDOFF.md first. Then implement all tasks from artifacts/architect/task-breakdown.md. Make all failing tests pass. Do NOT modify test files. Write artifacts/dev/implementation-notes.md. Save handoff to handoffs/dev-to-qa.md.

workspaces.name: QA Engineer (Verification)
workspaces.task_template: You are in VERIFICATION MODE. Run ./tests/run_tests.sh against the implementation. If all tests pass: produce artifacts/qa/sign-off.md and handoffs/qa-signoff.md with STATUS: COMPLETE. If tests fail: produce artifacts/qa/bug-report.md and handoffs/qa-to-dev-cycle.md with STATUS: BLOCKED.

parallel-phase-3.description: QA writes tests and Dev sets up project simultaneously

model_assignments._comment: Recommended model assignments. Adjust based on your budget and requirements.
